name: The Incident
source:
The Incident of 42 changed the world forever. Humanity’s survivors had to come together in one community, The Globe, on the last land reclaimed from the planet’s new rulers. 

Life is not what it used to be, but some people still try to enjoy what remains, knowing things could always get worse.

[From [url=https://blazoom-benedict.itch.io/the-incident-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
42号事件永远改变了世界。人类的幸存者必须聚集在一个社区——地球，这是从地球新统治者手中夺回的最后一块土地。

生活已不再是以前的样子，但有些人仍然试图享受剩下的一切，因为他们知道事情总是会变得更糟。

[来自[url=https://blazoom-benedict.itch.io/the-incident-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
